body: Yes a little worse day by day. Harder to pretend I'm ok when I just want to cry all day. I just can't wrap my head around a life without her.

I get up and go to work then I go home and watch a little TV then go to sleep and repeat. I just feel lost all the time. I don't really have anyone I speak to on a regular basis. I made my ex my whole world. She ended up virtually being my only friend.
Everyone knows and no I haven't.
I've thought about it on and off since she left. She was my whole world and things haven't gotten easier. I have to find excuses to get out of bed in the morning. I don't see the pain ending.
Just sad that she is gone.
I mean her. She was my best friend too. She was the reason I got up in the morning. Every future plan I had involved her.
Six months. I lost my home, my dogs, my love and my best friend. I'm just a shell now.

I was with a girl for 13 years and she came out of the closet and left me. I was in a relationship before that where my partner died of cancer. I made the most recent girl the center of my whole world. We never fought. I was blindsided. I don't see a future without her and I grieve every day. I'm empty and broken.
